messages:
alexa: UX wants saved-query previews to show estimated token cost and likely route without actually touching quotas. How do we make the estimate believable? :thinking:

matt: Two parts: client estimator using cached tokenizer metadata, or a lightweight server preview endpoint that returns non-billable estimates. Client estimator is low infra, server endpoint gives more accurate routing likelihoods.

rina: Ops: absolutely no runtime calls that increment quota for previews. If server endpoint exists it must be explicitly non-billable and rate-limited, and tenants must be able to opt-out.

alexa: Also need a clear UI signal when estimate may diverge from execution (templated params, route hints). Show confidence % and a small tooltip.

matt: Proposal: /meta/tokenizer?model=... -> tokens_per_char, avg_prompt_overhead, per_token_cost. Client computes estimate and shows confidence. For routing, /preview/route-check?saved_query_id=... returns route likelihoods (no prompt text). Cached per-org.

rina: Telemetry: emit `preview_estimate` sampled events with tenant_hash, saved_query_id, model_family, estimated_tokens_bin, route_likelihood_bucket, confidence. No text. Execution emits `query_execute` unsampled and can include the ephemeral preview_nonce to correlate.

alexa: Add tenant flag `console.previews` {enabled|disabled|sandbox-only}. sandbox-only forces server preview endpoints; disabled hides preview UI. Default enabled for most orgs.

matt: UX: accuracy badge on saved-query list (p95 accuracy after we collect data). Also show when a saved-query contains routing hints that may not be honored and mark as "suggestion".

rina: Security: previews must not persist prompt contents. Only hashes/ids. Sampling default 1% for preview telemetry.

ops-bot: rollout scheduled: preview-estimate-proto -> staging at 1715813600 :rocket:

alexa: Great. I'll draft a short RFC for the metadata shape and the preview_nonce flow. Meeting tomorrow to agree on retention and sampling. Thanks! :thumbsup:
